# Kawaki Studios
> Bespoke Editorial Engineering, Headless Commerce, and Spatial Digital Flagships.

Kawaki Studios (https://www.kawaki.co.in) is a premier digital engineering and web design studio founded by Kunal Sharma. We engineer custom publishing platforms, high-velocity headless Shopify Plus architectures, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences with sub-second performance for ambitious brands globally.

## Core Services & Architecture
- [Headless Commerce & Shopify Plus](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Sub-second catalog navigation, Shopify Hydrogen, custom cart mutations, and edge caching (<200ms TTFB).
- [Editorial Engineering & CMS](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Bespoke content architectures, surgical typography systems, strict WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility, and markdown-backed editorial pipelines.
- [3D & Spatial Digital Experiences](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): WebGL, Three.js, GPU-accelerated micro-physics, interactive 3D product visualizers, and kinetic brand identities.
